text:
mason: hey — PR #4821 ready except CI failing on gofumpt. It's just a tiny rename + proto json_name tweak. ptal? https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4821

jia: glanced — lgtm on logic. can you split the gofumpt change into its own commit? makes CI easier.

mason: yeah can do. the problem is gofumpt rewrite on generated files; shows rewrap in proto_gen. thinking of keeping regen as a separate commit + a small fmt-only commit. not sure about adding a skip directive.

sara: we don't have a skip. better: split the regen into its own commit and mark it in the PR desc. that'll make review and blamelogs clear. also leave a one-line note in the changelog so release notes don't confuse consumers.

marta: i can give final approve after split. also tiny nit — prefer snake_case for json_name (api_id not apiID).

ops-bot: CI failed — gofumpt check failed on proto/gen/serializer.go

mason: split pushed (commits: 'regen: proto client' and 'style: apply gofumpt'). PTAL @marta @sara

marta: reviewed, left a single suggestion to rename the generated field mapping so json_name becomes `api_id`. pushed suggestion commit.

jia: :thumbsup: LGTM after that. @mason can you squash the fmt + regen commits into a single change for history? i don't have merge perms today.

devops-jen: i can merge when CI is green. ping me in-thread when ready.

mason: squashed and CI is green. @devops-jen can you merge when you have a sec?

devops-jen: merged commit 3f2a9b2. thanks everyone :tada:
